methodology: Canonical regular-season 5-Year Peak. Each included season must qualify at >=60% of that season schedule and >=1400 minutes. Valid windows are five consecutive qualifying seasons or a six-calendar-year span containing exactly five qualifying seasons and exactly one missing/non-qualifying season; qualifying seasons are never intentionally skipped. Peak selection uses the mean authoritative season SDI v4 WOWY. Peak statistics aggregate underlying totals/attempts/possessions and rate statistics are MP-weighted.
